h1: Event Wi-Fi in NYC that holds up.
sub: Temporary Wi-Fi and wired networks for conferences, trade shows, pop-ups and productions across New York. Show traffic kept apart from guest traffic, a backup line ready, and someone watching it the whole time.

items: Access points placed for the number of devices, not just the size of the space
Switches and cabling for playback, streaming, check-in and payments
Show, production and guest traffic on their own networks
A second internet path and monitoring during the event
Guests, staff, screens, cameras and point-of-sale.
Access points, switching and the internet line, with a backup.
Every network and the failover tested on site.
Monitored through the event, then packed out.
Midtown offices, hotel ballrooms, SoHo storefronts, galleries and rooftops.
Warehouses, studios and lofts in Brooklyn and Long Island City, minutes from where the gear is packed.
Schools, campuses, parks and public spaces across the other boroughs, and Jersey City and Long Island too.
Why not use the building Wi-Fi?
You cannot control it or see into it, and it is shared with everyone else. When streaming, check-in and payments depend on it, a network of your own is safer.
Can you provide internet for an event?
We plan the internet connection with the space, add a backup path, and build the Wi-Fi and wired network on top.
Yes. UniFi networks for offices and buildings, with structured cabling and support.
Is someone on site during the event?
Yes. The network is monitored while the event runs, with a technician on hand.

quote.h: Start with what you need and when.
quote.lead: Tell us where, when, how many people and what has to happen. We reply with one quote for equipment, crew and delivery.
